catalog.container_strategy: Install licensed suite and compile only on dev. Stage prebuilt executables, required harness/data, reference outputs and runtimes on the target. Keep private test inputs inaccessible to the development agent.

deployment.qualification_scope: Reference commands only. A reviewed local payload and installation receipt must supply exact executable paths, arguments, license admission and feature probes.
deployment.target_exports_policy: Explicit licensed component exports from the reviewed vendor receipt only; never copy a compiler toolkit or complete source/test corpus by default.

catalog.purpose: Support comparability with earlier compiler literature and established workloads as a separately reported suite.
qualification_gaps: A licensed local payload, exact delivered build identity, SHA-256, accepted license receipt and reviewed silent installation recipe are required.
The selected resource remains blocked until installation and real component probes succeed.
Run-rule-compliant results and research estimates must be distinguished. Training/tuning on a test input invalidates a claimed held-out test.
No benchmark sources or licensed inputs belong in the public repository or public OCI image.
catalog.size_basis: Official SPEC download checksum table exact ISO byte count; licensed ISO and local SHA-256 are not included.
